# Silly Travel Tool — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Silly Travel Tool is a travel planner that turns booking emails into one itinerary per trip, with the weather for your dates.

## What it does
- Imports bookings from confirmation emails: forward one and it lands in the right trip
- Keeps one itinerary per trip, day by day, in each place's local time
- Shows the weather for your trip dates
- Shared trips: invite people by email to see and plan the same trip (an invited person who accepts sees the whole trip, but never your documents or loyalty cards)
- City guides for destinations worldwide
- HONK: nearby place picks by mood, using your location only when you allow it
- A packing list for each trip, kept on your device
- Translate and phrase book (typed translations are kept on your device)
- Currency conversion, tip and split, and emergency SOS numbers by country
- Travel documents and loyalty cards, private to you
- Goose score and badges, personal and private to you
- Goose inbox: a private email address for forwarding bookings

## URL
https://sillytraveltool.com

## More
- Guide and FAQ: https://sillytraveltool.com/help/
